paite: Ephraim tanggam Ramathaim-zophim ah mi khat a-om a, amin Elkanah ahi a, amah Jeroham tapa, Elihu tapa, Tohu tapa, Ephraim mi Zuph tapa ahi.
heading: Elkanah Leh A-inkuan Shiloh Ah
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

paite: Ama'n zi nih anei a, akhat min Hannah ahi, akhat min Peninnah ahi. Peninnah in tate anei a, Hannah in bel tate anei kei hi.
english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

paite: Huai mi akhua ua kipan Shiloh ah Sepaihte' TOUPA houpih ding leh kithoih ding in kum teng in ahohtou hi. Huai ah Eli tapate nih, Hophni leh Phinehas, TOUPA siampute a-om uhi.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.

paite: Elkanah kithoih ni ahong tun in, azi Peninnah leh atapate leh atanute tengteng tantuan abawlsak hi.
english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

paite: Hannah tan nih abawlsak a, Hannah lah a-it mahmah ngal a. Himahleh TOUPA'N asul akhaksak hi.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

paite: TOUPA'N asul akhaksak ziak in alangnu'n alungkhamsak nak hi.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

paite: Huchibang a kum teng a ahih ziak in TOUPA inn ahohtouh teng in alungkhamna atokthou nak hi. Huchi in akapkap a, an leng ane kei.
english: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

paite: Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hannah, bang achia ahia na kah? Bang achia an ne lou na hia? Bang achia lungkham na hia? Tapa sawm sang in nang a ding in ka hoihzaw kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

paite: Huchi in Shiloh a anek ua adawn khit un Hannah adingh a, siampu Eli TOUPA tempul kong khuambul a atutna ah atu hi,
heading: Hannah Leh Eli
english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Hannah lungsim haksa mahmah in a-om a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a, khase mahmah in akap hi.
english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.

paite: Thu achiam a, "Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, na sikhanu gimna en a, na hon theihgige a, na sikhanu na hon mangngilh louh a, na sikhanu tapa na piakleh adamsung teng TOUPA ka pe dia, alu ah mulmetna zat ahi kei ding,” achi hi.
english: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA ma a athum san lai in Eli in amuk-phun ana chiamteh hi.
english: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.

paite: Hannah in alungtang in agen a, amuk kia atangsak a, a-aw bel zak ahi kei hi. Huaiziak in Eli in zukham asa hi.
english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

paite: Huchi in Eli in akiang ah, "Bang tan ahia kham a na om nilouh ding? Na uain koihmang in," achi hi.
english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

paite: Hannah in, "Kham kei veng e, ka toupa. Lungsim lungkham mahmah numei ka hi. Uain leng, zu chik leng ka dawn kei, TOUPA ma ah ka lungsim ka suahkhia ahi zaw.
english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

paite: Na sikhanu Belial tanu in hon ngoh het ke'n. Ka lungsim a dimlet lunggimna leh ka lungkhamna genkhia ka hi zaw hi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

paite: Eli in, "Lungmuangtak in pai in, Israelte' Pathian in na thilnget nang hon pia hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na sikhanu na mitmuh in deihsakna musak in," achi hi. Huchi in numei apaita a, an ane a, lungkham mel aputa kei hi.
english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

paite: Zingsangpi in athou ua, TOUPA abia ua, apai ua, Ramah a a-inn uh atung nawnta uh. Elkanah in azi Hannah akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N amah atheigige hi.
heading: Samuel Pianna Leh Latna
english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hannah in nau apai a, ahun ahong tun in tapa anei hi. "TOUPA ka nget ziak in," chi in amin Samuel asa hi.
english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Elkanah leh a-inkote tengteng TOUPA ma a kum teng a akithoihna uh lan ding leh athuchiam uh tangtun ding in ahong paitou uhi.
english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

paite: Hannah bel ahohtou kei hi. Apasal kiang ah, "Kei zaw naupang in nawinek atawp masiah ka hohtou kei ding. Huai hun chiang in TOUPA ma a akilat theihna ding in ka pi ding. Huai ah a-om nilouhta ding," achi hi.
english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever.”

paite: Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hoih ding na chih bang zel in hih in. Anawinek na tawpsak tan in om in. Himahleh TOUPA'N athu hihkip lel hen," achi hi. Huchi in nawinek atawp masiah huai ah numei a-om a, atapa nawinek atawp masiah nawi anesak hi.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.

paite: Nawinek atawptak in, tangbuang ephah khat leh uain thawl khat tawi in bawngtal kum thum a upa toh Shiloh a TOUPA inn ah ata naupang chik paipih in, apitou hi.
english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

paite: Bawngtal khat gou in, naupang Eli kiang ah api uhi.
english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa, na hin bang in ka gen ahi, kei zaw, aw toupa, hiai lai a na kiang a dingh a TOUPA kiang a thum numei ka hi.
english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.

paite: Hiai naupang ngen in ka thum a, TOUPA'N ka nget ahon peta.
english: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Adamsung teng TOUPA a dia lat ahi," achi hi. Huai ah ama'n TOUPA abia hi.
english: Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.
